independentByteVerification.method: Fetched and fully read all five original sources from exact 6ade primary GitHub files. Independently applied each pinned replacement once, verified all five complete candidate UTF-8 sizes/SHA256/Git blobs, reversed rules in reverse order, and recovered each complete original exactly. codeFindings: memberRoleOptions defaults to nil. For an editable identity, nil yields the exact former global grant list. A supplied map with a missing identity or an explicitly empty list yields no roles; noneditable identities always yield no roles. The initializer validates all map keys as valid/editable and rejects duplicate roles, None and Owner. This preserves existing Heart initializer/default semantics.

The shared role-change validator and the existing member-role menu both call rolesForMemberChange. The UI continues to omit the target's current role. The approval menu and approval validation continue to use the separate global grantableRoles list; remove/approve/identity-only-decline semantics remain exact.

The actual Native readSnapshot calls the new internal nonisolated static projector. The projector uses Sendable member/invitation/value data without actor state or new asynchronous work. The original active, nonself, nonOwner and Owner-only Admin-target removal predicate is retained. Guest is excluded from editable members while retaining independent removal eligibility.

The Native ordinary approval list is Reader/Writer, plus Admin for an Owner actor. A per-member Guest option is added only for a current Reader, for either Owner or Admin. Current Writer/Admin targets cannot be changed to Guest; an existing Guest cannot be upgraded. Owner targets and Admin actors targeting another Admin remain unavailable under the existing restrictions.

Native apply is byte-exact: session.perform obtains the current lease, readSnapshot refreshes the actual authority, mutation.validate consumes that refreshed projection, the original request uses lease.validate, and the original readback follows. Scope/member decoding, request IDs, HTTP routes and bodies are unchanged. A previously displayed Reader-to-Guest choice is therefore revalidated against the latest read snapshot before dispatch.

The exact official any-sync validator and models match the W1 hashes. CanManageAccounts is Owner/Admin; ValidatePermissionChange rejects Guest and Owner targets, restricts Admin target/grant to Owner, and permits Guest only from Reader. AccountRemove separately permits eligible Guest removal. Request approval has a distinct validator; this review does not infer a qualified Guest/None approval operation from parser or validator permissiveness.

expectedNativeVisibleRoleChoices.removal: Available only under the unchanged active/nonself/Owner/Admin restrictions.
